surface_verification.justification: Backend-affects-Frontend: this diff touches a WS handler (ws-upgrade-handler.ts) and a message-consuming client hook (useTerminalSocket.ts), so surface=web is mandatory regardless of file-path detection. Ran spec 105 against a real isolated single-process server (temp USERPROFILE/HOME, production client build, loopback-only, no chokidar/production stack touched) and a real Chromium via surface_verification.py's orchestrator: exit 0, 1 test run, both bugs proven end-to-end (mouseTrackingMode torn to 'none' after replay; Reopen reconnects the real WS without a page reload). Bug A's precondition is seeded via a direct <taskId>.snapshot fixture file (documented Windows ConPTY limitation for driving a live pty into that state — see iterate spec's E2E authoring finding), not a claim about the fix itself; the replay-only branch still reads that exact file through the real SnapshotStore/buildReplaySnapshotEnvelope and sends it over a real WS to a real xterm.js instance.
